central_principle: Equality at restoration time does not establish downstream counterfactual validity.

L0.forbidden_implication: L0 does not imply trajectory or decision fidelity.
L0.name: restore equality
L0.permitted_meaning: Only the measured exposed state agrees at the restoration boundary.

L1.name: one-step dynamics fidelity
L1.separation: Numerical differences and semantic differences are reported separately.

L2.name: finite-horizon open-loop trajectory fidelity
L2.requires: Identical recorded actions for uninterrupted and restored instances.

L3.measurement: Whether uninterrupted and restored branches produce the same declared conclusion.
L3.name: downstream decision fidelity
